title: Fixed Open Side Case and Lever Lockset
description: One complete newly authored fixed open-side door lockset appearance. One thick continuous back-and-rim case joins a projecting faceplate, with two genuine independent side ports. A whole blunt bevel-ended upper tongue and separate whole rectangular lower bolt project through the ports, held by rear guide roots. A complete transverse spindle, bored bearing collar and fixed visible cam connect to a full offset exterior lever handle. The inspection side is deliberately uncovered; it is not a closed working lock. No pin tumblers, cylinder, key, security profile or functioning internal mechanism is represented. Unlike a U-shackle padlock or raised-loop draw latch this whole assembly has an open box, twin side exits and a transverse handle. No old meshes imported. Three opaque PBR materials, metres, Z up and horizontal-bounds-centred ground origin. One static prop zero scenes. No locking, burglary resistance, key compatibility, motion, real lock construction, installation, access control or safety claim. Rigging and interaction not made.
